text: Propane, methoxymethane and ethanol have almost the same molar mass. Yet propane boils at minus forty two, the ether at minus twenty four, and ethanol at plus seventy eight degrees. The reason is hydrogen bonding. The O H hydrogen of one ethanol molecule is attracted to the oxygen of the next, and boiling means breaking that whole network.
